screen.Formula:
p_i = (W_i + 0.5*D_i + 0.5)/(N_i + 1)
R_i = label_i + 400*log10(p_i/(1-p_i))
v_i = (400/ln(10))^2/(N_i*p_i*(1-p_i))
weight_i = 1/v_i
R_pool = sum(weight_i*R_i)/sum(weight_i)
SE_pool = 1/sqrt(sum(weight_i))
CI95 = [R_pool - 1.96*SE_pool, R_pool + 1.96*SE_pool]

Bootstrap.Method: whole-opening jointly across anchors, both colors retained; percentile CI with linear interpolation (type 7)

A passing screen admits only the frozen candidate for separately authorized confirmation; it supplies no >3600 claim.
